          gh cache list --ref refs/heads/main --key dist- --limit 100 --json id,key,createdAt --jq '.[] | [.id, .createdAt, .key] | @tsv' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-caches.tsv"
          sh scripts/ci/stale-dist-caches.sh "$X64" "$ARM64" "$WASM" < "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-caches.tsv" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/stale.txt"
          {
            echo "## The stale dist- caches of main (docs/adr/0228)"
            echo
            echo "Before: $BEFORE"
            echo
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          while IFS= read -r id; do
            key=$(awk -F '\t' -v id="$id" '$1 == id { print $3 }' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-caches.tsv")
            gh cache delete "$id" < /dev/null
            echo "Deleted $id $key"
            echo "- deleted \`$key\` ($id)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          done < "$RUNNER_TEMP/stale.txt"
          if [ ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/stale.txt" ]; then echo "- nothing to delete" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; fi
          # the usage of the API is updated about every five minutes, and
          # may not show the deletions yet
          {
            echo
            echo "After: $(usage)"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  parser-fmt-manuscripts:
    needs: [changes, build]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.build == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        suite: [manuscripts, tables, arguments, eval]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: golem-linux-x86_64
          path: golem-linux-x86_64
      - name: Install Lean 4.7.0 for argument model comparison
        if: matrix.suite == 'arguments'
        run: sh scripts/ci/install-parser-proof-lean.sh
      - name: Check round trips with the candidate CLI
        env:
          SUITE: ${{ matrix.suite }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          chmod +x golem-linux-x86_64/golem
          export GOLEM="$PWD/golem-linux-x86_64/golem"
          sh experiments/parser-fmt-proof/check-suite.sh "$SUITE" 2 1
      - name: Save failing manuscripts and replay commands
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: parser-fmt-${{ matrix.suite }}-failures
          path: round-trip-failures
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  parser-fmt-proofs:
    needs: [changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.build == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/parser-fmt-proofs.yml

  # The one check of ci.yml that the protection of main requires: every job
  # succeeded, or was skipped for a change of documents only (docs/adr/0021)
  # the logs of the other jobs of the run are read for warnings, which
  # needs actions: read (docs/adr/0245)
  ci:
    needs: [changes, scripts-linux, build, determinism, visual, release-scripts, scripts-macos, format, plugins, editors, editors-lsp, verapdf, wasm, parser-fmt-proofs, parser-fmt-manuscripts]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Results of the jobs
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: printf '%s\n' "$NEEDS" | sh scripts/ci/gate.sh
      # every job of the run that has ended, but those skipped and those
      # cancelled before any step ran, which have no log; ci itself is
      # still running. The list of jobs comes from gh api, and each log,
      # which may hold terminal escape sequences that gh api refuses to
      # write, from the same API with curl in job-logs.sh, which reads the
      # other logs when one cannot be fetched and fails at the end
      # (docs/adr/0245 section 6, docs/adr/0427)
      - name: No warning in the logs of the jobs but the allowed ones (docs/adr/0245)
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/logs"
          GITHUB_API_READ_SECONDS=3600 timeout -k 10 3600 sh scripts/ci/github-api-read.sh --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/attempts/$RUN_ATTEMPT/jobs?per_page=100" \
            --jq '.jobs[]' >"$RUNNER_TEMP/jobs.json"
          sh scripts/ci/job-logs.sh scripts/ci/warnings-allowed.tsv "$RUNNER_TEMP/jobs.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/logs"
workflow_files..github/workflows/parser-fmt-proofs.yml:
name: Parser and formatter proofs
on:
  workflow_call:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 18 * * *"
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  prove:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        model: [eval/Eval, arguments/Arguments, tables/Table, grammar]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Lean 4.7.0
        run: sh scripts/ci/install-parser-proof-lean.sh
      - name: Check the model with Lean
        if: matrix.model != 'grammar'
        env:
          MODEL: ${{ matrix.model }}
        run: '"$LEAN" "experiments/parser-fmt-proof/$MODEL.lean"'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        if: matrix.model == 'grammar'
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
      - uses: haskell-actions/setup@0f8e8c99d88aeb3fbfd523f1ef2c6f762d10d64d # v2.12.1
        if: matrix.model != 'arguments/Arguments'
        with:
          ghc-version: "9.10.3"
          cabal-version: "3.18.2.0"
      - name: Update the Cabal index
        if: matrix.model != 'arguments/Arguments'
        run: cabal update
      - name: Build the pinned grammar tools
        if: matrix.model == 'grammar'
        run: |
          cabal build peg-cli:exe:peg-hs
          cabal build --only-dependencies lib:golem-bibliography
          echo "PEG_HS=$(cabal list-bin peg-cli:exe:peg-hs)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Compare table formatting in Haskell and Lean
        if: matrix.model == 'tables/Table'
        run: sh experiments/parser-fmt-proof/tables/compare-format.sh
      - name: Compare Emet evaluations in Haskell and Lean
        if: matrix.model == 'eval/Eval'
        run: sh experiments/parser-fmt-proof/eval/compare-eval.sh
      - name: Check grammar proofs, mutations and native parser examples
        if: matrix.model == 'grammar'
        run: node experiments/parser-fmt-proof/grammar/test.mjs
      - name: Require the full grammar model but the deferred choices
        if: matrix.model == 'grammar'
        run: |
          grammar=experiments/parser-fmt-proof/grammar
          node "$grammar/check-deferred.mjs" modules/golem-parser/grammar/Golem.hpeg "$grammar/deferred-choices.txt" "$RUNNER_TEMP/Generated.lean"
          "$LEAN" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/PegModel.olean" "$grammar/PegModel.lean"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          LEAN_PATH=. "$LEAN" Generated.lean

  nightly-cli:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
      - uses: haskell-actions/setup@0f8e8c99d88aeb3fbfd523f1ef2c6f762d10d64d # v2.12.1
        with:
          ghc-version: "9.10.3"
          cabal-version: "3.18.2.0"
      - name: Build the CLI from the scheduled revision
        run: |
          scripts/fetch-wasmtime.sh
          cabal update
          cabal build exe:golem
          echo "GOLEM=$(cabal list-bin exe:golem)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install Lean 4.7.0 for the nightly argument comparison
        run: sh scripts/ci/install-parser-proof-lean.sh
      - name: Check the nightly corpus
        run: |
          status=0
          for suite in manuscripts tables arguments eval; do
            sh experiments/parser-fmt-proof/check-suite.sh "$suite" 3 2 || status=1
          done
          exit "$status"
      - name: Save failing manuscripts and replay commands
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: parser-fmt-nightly-failures
          path: round-trip-failures
          if-no-files-found: ignore
